Bacterial_Leaf_Spot.quote: Small (1/25 to 1/5 inch) spots form in the leaves. Spots are irregular to angular and have a deep purple to rusty-brown or black color.
Small, round olive-brown to black spots form on the fruit. They are usually sunken and frequently surrounded by a water-soaked margin.
Spring cankers first appear as water-soaked, slightly darkened blisters about the time the first leaves appear.

Leaf_Curl.quote: Developing leaves become severely distorted (thickened and puckered), and have a reddish or purple cast.
Diseased twigs become swollen and stunted, and may have a slight golden cast.
Diseased fruit has shiny, reddish, raised, warty spots.
